prerequisites: EM1012 - Mecànica de Màquines i Estructures
EM1015 - Ciència i Tecnologia de Materials
EM1019 - Elasticitat i Resistència de Materials
EM1020 - Teoria de Màquines i Mecanismes
EM1028 - Màquines i Instal·lacions de Fluids

learning_outcomes.text: Be able to perform teamwork applying the knowledge acquired on refrigeration and air conditioning installations.
Be able to solve problems related to refrigeration and air conditioning installations.
Correctly use the basic technical terminology of air conditioning and refrigeration installations, in English.
Be able to autonomously expand and acquire knowledge related to refrigeration and air conditioning installations.
Be able to identify the elements and equipment that integrate air conditioning and/or refrigeration installations.

Be able to apply the acquired knowledge to design, dimension and select the main elements of an air conditioning and/or refrigeration installation, as well as for the integral selection of the most suitable refrigerant.
Be able to calculate the thermal loads to be absorbed in air conditioning and/or refrigeration installations.

syllabus_topics: Unit 1.2. Food preservation and thermal loads in cold rooms. Project phases and calculations
Unit 1.3. Refrigerants. Historical evolution, main characteristics, current situation and future forecasts.
Unit 1.4. Refrigeration technology. Main and secondary components
Unit 1.5. Refrigeration systems, configurations and legislation
Unit 2.1. Introduction to air conditioning systems and their relevance
Unit 2.2. Thermal loads to compensate through air conditioning systems. Project phases and calculations
Unit 2.3. Psychrometry. Introduction and application in air conditioning
Unit 2.4. Types of heat and cold production systems
Unit 2.5. Air conditioning systems. Water, air, and refrigerant, and combinations thereof.
Unit 2.6. Air diffusion and component calculation.
Exposition of projects to be carried out during the course.
Show the operation of computer programs that will allow the project to be carried out, both for load calculation and for the design of the circuit and its components.
Address practical cases of refrigeration and air conditioning.
Resolve doubts about the proposed projects and continue working on them in the classroom with the support of the teacher.
P1. Visit to a company specialized in the design, manufacture and marketing of refrigerated furniture for food sales.
P2. Visit to a supermarket refrigeration installation.
P3. Visit to Espaitec UJI air conditioning installation.
P4. Visit to UJI swimming pool DHW, air conditioning, renewable energy and machine room installations.
teaching_methods: Class debates on component/system selection and economic/environmental impact
Laboratory sessions (use of equipment and computer tools)

assessment_methods.method: Continuous assessment: Air conditioning installation project

assessment_rules: To pass the course, students must obtain at least 5 out of 10 points in the overall average grade. For the first call, a minimum grade of 5/10 is required for each continuous assessment part (refrigeration project, air conditioning project, practical sessions) and 4/10 for the final exam. Failure to meet these minimums or the 80% attendance requirement for practical sessions will result in a maximum global average grade of 4.5/10. For the second call, grades for passed continuous assessment parts are maintained, and the same minimum grades apply for recovery. The extraordinary final exam accounts for 100% of the grade with no minimum mark required.
